about: Lavaltrie is a city in Lanaudière, Quebec, on the north shore of the St. Lawrence River between Repentigny and Lanoraie. A riverside setting, local services, and Highway 40 corridor access define a growing North Shore community with views across the river. About 14,000 people live in Lavaltrie.
